content.text: The problem is clear: in Nigeria, digital creators are locked out of global [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|Payment Methods]] platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. This leaves them struggling to collect payments for ebooks, courses, and other digital products. The solution is not a workaround, but a fully sovereign digital commerce stack that gives creators control over their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal|infrastructure]], processing orders in under 30 seconds and delivering files instantly. This post will break down the key components of a Google Apps Script-based digital commerce automation system and how it works, without the need for Stripe or any other restricted platform.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

A Google Apps Script-based digital commerce automation system is a custom-built infrastructure solution that combines a Google Apps Script backend, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing and delivery. This setup allows digital creators to manage orders, automate delivery, and process payments without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This approach provides full control over the infrastructure, enables rapid order processing, and ensures instant file delivery to customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a Google Apps Script-based digital commerce automation system is built around a backend script that processes incoming orders, verifies payments, and triggers file delivery. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle webhook events from payment gateways, enabling seamless order processing and automated delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets is used for storing order data, providing a scalable and secure solution for managing customer information and order history.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who are looking for a fully sovereign digital commerce stack that can process orders in under 30 seconds, without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal. These creators can sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products, knowing that their customers will receive their purchases instantly, and that their infrastructure is under their full control.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically and is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates.

Set up NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and seamless payment processing.
Does the Google Apps Script still work?

Does the Google Apps Script still work? Yes, it still works and can be used to build a fully sovereign digital commerce stack that processes orders in under 30 seconds and delivers files instantly. Google Apps Script is a powerful tool that enables custom-built infrastructure solutions, and it continues to be a viable option for digital creators who want to manage their own infrastructure and automate their digital commerce operations.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Google Apps Script used for?

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool that enables custom-built infrastructure solutions, including digital commerce automation systems. It can be used to automate order processing, trigger delivery, and verify payments, making it an ideal choice for digital creators who want to manage their own infrastructure and automate their digital commerce operations.
Does Google Apps Script cost money?

Google Apps Script is a free service provided by Google, but it does require a Google account to use. Additionally, some third-party services like NOWPayments may charge fees for their services, but these fees are typically low and predictable.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers instead of Google Apps Script?

Yes, you can use Cloudflare Workers instead of Google Apps Script to build a digital commerce automation system. Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that provides a scalable and secure solution for processing and delivering orders, making it an ideal choice for digital creators who want to automate their digital commerce operations.
How do I store order data?

You can use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data, providing a scalable and secure solution for managing customer information and order history. Both options are highly customizable and can be integrated with your Google Apps Script backend to ensure seamless order processing and automated delivery.
How do I verify payments?

You can use NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, enabling seamless payment processing and instant order fulfillment. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low fee of 0.5% for each transaction.
